purpose: Evaluate a baseline-aligned field controller, its state abstraction, independent task and retention outcomes, complete cost, and the interaction with a trainable Hepta temporal module.

source_references.new_source_commit: See phase-specific SOURCE_FREEZE records; self-referential protocol commit hashes are intentionally external.

freeze_prerequisites: Root replaces this draft with a separately named final protocol and source freeze before scientific model calls; a draft cannot authorize a runner.
Record exact Python, NumPy, CPU Torch, BLAS, thread, deterministic-algorithm, device and dispatch identities.
Verify recovered model, observer, corpus and prior-registry bytes against their existing identities.
Verify actual scientific-kernel capture, literal restore, paired replay, incoming gradients, RNG, immutable original guard and branch-order invariance before bank construction.
Audit actual f_bavail, inodes and serializer-measured bounds for raw evidence, failed writes, one archive and a full literal restore.
Verify the fixed stage-C warm-up, controller-bank, baseline, adaptation and operation counts against its executable dependency closure before model outcomes.
Complete the stage-C warm-up, controller-bank, baseline-selection and operation schedule before any stage-C outcomes.
Freeze source-pair allocation, all methods, seeds, schedules, effects, multiplicity, budgets and stopping rules before the applicable phase.
Distinguish current-run integrity from the unresolved historical exact-regression gate; do not change the latter's tolerance.
Endpoint and audit-observer access occurs only after the applicable complete-path seal and independent integrity check.

complete_branch_checkpoint: mutable parameters and buffers with names, types, shapes and bytes
complete supported CPU SGD state and immutable parameter-group semantics
incoming gradients, distinguishing None from zero
CPU, Python, NumPy and declared named-generator RNG states
clock, decision index, remaining scheduled microsteps and resource state
immutable original guard panel, baseline values and context identities
complete remaining paired schedule for replay infrastructure
controller history and immutable head, normalizer, baseline and threshold identities
controller_input_exclusions: future random or data tapes, realized future marks and future labels
branch terminal returns at the current deployment decision
qualification or final endpoint tensors and outcomes
audit-observer outputs during training or policy fitting
state_and_filtration.common_disclosed_stream: Current legal H12 measurement, executed past actions, observed past guard outcomes, logical clock and already consumed resources. Complete-current-state intentionally receives additional current mutable model/optimizer state.
state_and_filtration.action_effect_identity: Compare dynamically relevant state, optimizer, RNG, clock, guard, remaining budget and controller memory separately from provenance metadata; compare actual costs separately. Physical parameter equality alone is insufficient.
state_and_filtration.restore_boundary: Between complete transactions with no pending autograd graph and no concurrent writer; PyTorch version counters are not claimed to be restored.

task_and_data.task: Existing MNIST source-pair image and caption generation with the registered heavy_noise, missing, occlusion and clean conditions; this is a controlled small multimodal task.
task_and_data.pixel_domain: Individual source digits are 28 by 28 (784 pixels); paired generated images are 28 by 56 (1568 pixels).
task_and_data.allocation_rule: Unique pixel identities, conflicting duplicate-label exclusion only, fixed salt hash ordering, consecutive role allocations and adjacent source pairs; no outcome or class-based selection.

fresh_qualification.access: Only after stage-B paths, models, controller bytes and statistical procedure have been sealed; never used for features, guard, head fitting or action selection.

fresh_final.access: Sealed until every final architecture, policy, training script, checkpoint and scoring/statistical script is frozen; one joint final opening. No final-driven refit or model choice.

task_and_data.freshness_claim: Disjoint from all recorded prior allocations and task outcomes, not proof of unknown pretraining exclusion, new writers or a new dataset population.

shared_guard48_learning.optimizer: Pinned original CPU SGD with momentum 0.9 and unchanged V3 learning, clipping, rehearsal and teacher-anchor settings.
shared_guard48_learning.guard_reference: Immutable original model guard, not a moving accepted-state baseline.
shared_guard48_learning.rejection: Restore full transaction entry state, consume the scheduled positions, advance logical time and charge all attempted work.
shared_guard48_learning.zero_action: Execute and charge scheduled gradient and guard work without advancing parameters or momentum; not early termination.

controller_contract.ordinary: Fixed released baseline action by original model seed; no unnecessary feature instrumentation.

field12.context: Fixed model, action set, original guard, feature/panel identities, frozen normalizer, baseline and head are additional declared context; not a context-free Markov sufficiency claim.

full_current_state.dimension_rule: Flatten the complete current mutable parameter, buffer, momentum and incoming-gradient inventory, with declared absence masks and clock/resource coordinates, relative to the fixed immutable environment. Record exact ordered names and dimensions before fitting.
full_current_state.scope: Complete current trainable parameters, moments, incoming gradients/masks, buffers, guard values, clock and SGD coordinates, augmented by H12; conditional on fixed immutable environment. Replay RNG and future tape are inaccessible to all heads. This learned high-dimensional predictor is not a full-information optimum.

history6.slot_layout: H12 (12), that completed slot executed-action one-hot (4), its observed guard accepted flag (1), its scheduled microsteps / 48 (1), slot-valid (1). The current decision slot contains only H12 and valid=1; its action/guard/work remain zero until observed.
history6.padding: Chronological slots from oldest to current; right-pad future slots with zeros. At most five completed slots precede the current slot; no future action or outcome is supplied.
history6.cost_description: Computes the same expensive H12 probes; do not call it a cheap controller. Low additional history arithmetic is not low total observation cost.

controller_contract.label: A_b(s,a;omega) = G_b(s,a;omega) - G_b(s,b;omega), using the same first guarded transaction and then the fixed ordinary baseline through the common terminal step 288.
controller_contract.label_scope: Paired realized reference-tail contrast, not exact expected Q_b and not the replanned deployed policy's value.

fit.normalization: Fit-partition-only coordinate means and population standard deviations; fixed 1e-8 scale floor. Retain actual means/scales and the number of constant coordinates; calibration and deployment never refit them.
fit.numerics: Float64 centered linear ridge with unpenalized intercept; penalty lambda=1 in the unaveraged squared-error objective. Full-state may use the algebraically identical dual solve.
fit.outputs: Three nonbaseline advantages; baseline output is exactly zero.
fit.capacity_caveat: Same linear family and penalty do not imply equal effective degrees of freedom across dimensions; publish ranks and conditioning.

calibration.per_seed_per_head_rule: tau = max(0, max over calibration rows and nonbaseline actions of predicted_advantage minus realized_advantage).
calibration.deployment: Choose a unique best nonbaseline action only if its predicted advantage is strictly greater than tau; otherwise choose baseline. Any tie keeps baseline.
calibration.missing_nonfinite_or_out_of_contract_inp: Record failure and baseline fallback only where prospectively supported; integrity failures stop the phase.
calibration.scope: A maximum on twelve dependent calibration states is not a deployment-uniform or 95-percent conformal certificate.
calibration.greedy_diagnostics: Calibration accuracy/regret are ungated greedy predictions; deployment is separately logged after strict tau and tie fallback.

controller_contract.measurement_cost_scope: Actual richer30 measurement followed by H12 selection; shared instrumentation builds all three representations. Report measured total implementation cost, not an optimized H12-only lower bound.

stage_A.name: Aligned labels and complete-current-state/history mechanism development
prefixes: same scheduled old balanced exploration path
stage_A.grouping: Both prefixes and all six decision states of one schedule stay together; record exact duplicate state identities; rows are not independent samples.
stage_A.endpoint_barrier: Seal all 48 paths before development task/clean scoring with both observers.

screen_only.full_state_contrast: Always report; no automatic interpretation as optimal information loss.
screen_only.claim: Development mechanism only; favorable values do not establish original B03-B07 or independent efficacy.

stage_A.inactive_rule: Zero field overrides together with complete same-guard baseline terminal identities rejects this candidate as inactive; do not lower tau.

stage_B.name: Independent task, retention and full-cost assessment on fixed historical models
stage_B.checkpoints: Use stage-A frozen heads, normalizers and taus; each path starts from the common original model/optimizer state and retains the unchanged original guard.
stage_B.training_data_scope: The exposed development adaptation panels remain fixed; independence is in withheld endpoint source pairs and new training schedules, not new pretrained models or unseen adaptation panels.
stage_B.endpoint_access: Open fresh qualification task/clean only after all 240 paths plus all three COMPLETE records and checkpoint hashes seal; audit observer is endpoint-only.
stage_B.baseline_endpoint: Also score each immutable original model as frozen reference; do not count repeated original outputs as new model replicas.
stage_B.activity_failure_handling: If field is inactive in A, retain and execute the prespecified comparison to quantify equality and cost; no adoption is possible from merely adding extra evaluation samples.
stage_B.replication_scope: Inference is conditional on three fixed historical models; schedules are model-within training randomness and source pairs are task sampling units.

statistics.resampling: Paired schedule IDs independently within each fixed model, shared across methods and observers; one shared source-pair resample across models/methods/conditions for task, and a separate shared clean-pair resample; equal fixed-model and condition weights; do not resample three models as a model population.
statistics.interval: Predeclared equal-tail percentile intervals with alpha/10 per observer; approximate resampling intervals, not finite-sample exact coverage.
statistics.field_advantage_claim: Both observers require lower interval bound(field-ordinary)>0.001 and lower bound(field-history)>0; field task differences must be nonnegative in each fixed model and field clean lower bound must exceed -0.01. Report every other contrast regardless of sign.
statistics.ordinary_gain_claim: Both observers require lower interval bound(ordinary-frozen)>0 and clean lower bound>-0.01; report the 0.005 development target separately.
statistics.secondary_scope: Taper task/clean intervals belong to the same ten-comparison family; cost is reported in physical units, without a post-hoc exchange rate.

fixed_taper.rule: For seed-specific baseline index b use [b,b,2,1,1,0].
fixed_taper.description: Predetermined discrete clock taper; not a tuned optimum or a fitted cosine scheduler.
fixed_taper.scope: Secondary cost/performance comparator; strong ordinary remains the historically selected constant b.

stage_C.name: Trainable temporal architecture by controller factorial

architecture.implementation: TrainablePortfolio derived from the existing NeuralPortfolio; replace text_encoder and text_decoder only with matched input projections and the pinned _ContinuousCell(width, mode, direct).
architecture.dual: Pinned FPT mean plus interval-reset event law.
architecture.ordinary: Same state shape, active parameters and initial tensors with the pinned sigmoid event law.
architecture.shared_initialization: Within a paired seed, common modules and matched temporal parameter tensors start bitwise equal; controller arms start from their common architecture checkpoint.
architecture.other_latent_actions: Existing latent MLP actions remain; do not claim the entire generator or every controller has been replaced by Hepta.

stage_C.baseline_selection: Fixed action index 2, multiplier 1.0, for both architectures and every seed. No per-architecture outcome-driven reselection. This matched conventional baseline is not called the best tuned controller.
stage_C.field_fitting: Fit architecture-compatible field heads and baseline-aligned labels with the same lawful observations, action set, guard kernel, fitting budget and selection opportunities. Reusing incompatible old-generator heads without a declared transfer experiment is prohibited.
stage_C.field_coordinate_5: relative_full_parameter_displacement = ||theta-theta_warmstart||_2 / max(||theta_warmstart||_2, epsilon); C trains the full portfolio and has no old LoRA up/down operator. Record epsilon in the final implementation freeze.
stage_C.boundary_gradient_state: At each C microstep boundary zero_grad(set_to_none=True); incoming gradients are therefore all None by the declared algorithm, not omitted from state inventory.

prefixes: old balanced four-action exploration path indexed by schedule
controller_bank_schedule.fitting: Pool development seeds within each architecture; schedules 7000-7002 give 72 fit states and schedule 7003 gives 24 calibration states per architecture.
controller_bank_schedule.label: A_b uses one candidate macro16 followed by baseline index 2 to common terminal step 96, with identical guarded transition and paired tape.
controller_bank_schedule.head: field12 only for C; one fit per architecture
controller_bank_schedule.gate: tau=max(0,max calibration overprediction); unique nonbaseline advantage must exceed tau strictly, else baseline.

adaptation_steps_and_guard.teacher: Each path architecture own immutable warmstart model
adaptation_steps_and_guard.guard_reference: Each architecture/seed own immutable warmstart reward-clean guard
adaptation_steps_and_guard.optimizer: Warm-up SGD state carried to adaptation; any exception must be declared before freeze, never silently reset.

stage_C.freeze_blocker: Actual active parameter/state counts, measured artifact layout and independent code/protocol agreement remain required; the listed algorithm values and sample counts cannot be tuned after outcomes.
stage_C.final_endpoint_source: The sealed 3952-image final allocation, with fixed common source-pair, condition and noise tapes across all main arms.
stage_C.retention_estimands: Each main arm relative to its immutable pre-adaptation architecture checkpoint; report task and retention jointly.

statistics.resampling: Resample the eight paired training seeds jointly across all four arms and observers, plus a shared task source-pair resample and a separate shared clean source-pair resample; report every seed-level effect.
statistics.formal_family: Four declared task effects including interaction, plus four retention effects.
statistics.interval: Equal-tail percentile intervals with alpha/8 per observer, explicitly approximate with only eight training seeds.
statistics.interaction_claim: Lower interval bound(interaction)>0 under both observers, with the prespecified retention requirement; no superadditivity claim from a positive single arm.

optional_GRU.status: Optional diagnostic, not a replacement for any main arm.
optional_GRU.activation_rule: Can be enabled only in a distinct pre-outcome freeze with its own parameter/state/compute matching and budget; never after seeing main-arm results to choose a weaker comparator.

stage_C.development_seed_role: Two development seeds per architecture; both architectures share each seed and all designated data/noise opportunities. They are disjoint from evaluation seeds.

warmup.objective: Original teacher-forced joint task loss; no teacher anchor during warm-up.

checkpoint_evidence.branch_state: Complete independently restored in-memory snapshot for each branch; persist all exact branch input/transition/output hashes, schedules, labels, trace and replay recipe.
checkpoint_evidence.scope: Branch states not persisted as full tensor checkpoints are reconstructible/replay evidence, not literal restoration of original branch bytes. Do not claim every branch checkpoint was archived.
checkpoint_evidence.required_branch_replay: Before final freeze specify deterministic independent replay coverage and charge it; disagreement is an integrity failure.

actual_parameter_counts.matching: all named tensors and complete initialization identical before mode-specific training

record: all feature and directional reverse work
all generator, teacher and both-observer work
independent audit and literal restore work
raw_required: A: every parent and branch-terminal checkpoint; C: declared persistent warmstarts/endpoints plus complete branch trace/hash/reconstruction evidence, without a false literal-branch-archive claim
paired raw branch outputs and all four labels
per-source raw task and clean outputs
cost_and_evidence.complete_archive_and_literal_restore: Literal restore of every artifact that is actually persisted; reconstruction-only C branch states have an explicitly separate replay claim.
cost_and_evidence.external_raw_persistence: Requires the task's applicable destination authorization and current tool approval; this protocol does not bypass prior rejected raw-archive uploads.
cost_and_evidence.production_authority: No production selection, owner activation or deployment is implied by research completion.

failure_and_completion.integrity_failure: Stop the affected scientific phase immediately, seal partial evidence and all work; do not score results as a scientific comparison.
failure_and_completion.resource_exhaustion: Stop and preserve exact progress; do not omit raw files or discard failed branches to fit the budget.
failure_and_completion.dependency_block: Record exact unavailable package, asset, symbol or unsupported runtime and attempted authorized resolution. Report prepared/not-executed or execution-incomplete; never replace the real kernel with a synthetic model while retaining the same study claim.
failure_and_completion.recovery: Only a prospectively documented state-identical continuation after independent integrity review; no favorable-outcome retries.
failure_and_completion.inactive_candidate: Preserve the inactive rejection and complete any separately prespecified comparisons; no threshold relaxation, optional sample enlargement or hidden comparator substitution.

execution_resources.storage: isolated 4 GiB tmpfs under the task-owned workspace, created inside a private user/mount namespace; no other build artifacts removed
execution_resources.backup: Preallocated 1040 MiB task-owned archive file on separate host tmpfs; final gzip archive plus full literal member restore verification in private tmpfs; no raw external upload

net_benefit_policy.unconditional_net_gain: Require task/retention gates and measured quality-cost Pareto improvement; do not choose a cost exchange rate after observing outcomes
net_benefit_policy.report: all physical CPU/wall/work counts, one-time label/fitting cost separately, deployed cost, and conditional break-even task-utility per CPU-second where defined

resource_envelopes.binding: execution_resources gives actual global storage and runtime enforcement; no historical resource gate changed

stage_W.name: Prespecified H12 hidden momentum direction diagnostic
stage_W.construction: m_reflected = 2 * projection_on_direction_span(m) - m; all parameters and all other state unchanged; float64 SVD with relative rank cutoff1e-10 then float32 moments
stage_W.near_field_criterion: maximum absolute H12 difference / maximum(fit-only field standard deviation,1e-8) <= 1e-5
stage_W.labels: first candidate guarded action then own baseline through common clock288; original four labels from exactly matched A bank parent
stage_W.selection: all three predetermined parents, no search or outcome-based direction choice
stage_W.claims: Constructed state diagnostic only; no guarantee of reachable policy occupancy, no new independent efficacy claim, no adjustment of numerical threshold after outcome
